pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregularly shaped tan polygons with sharp, jagged edge gradients. Patches on the cervical region exhibit smaller spatial area, increasing in size towards the mid-flank and shoulder.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous off-white network of light pelage. The topology consists of frequent tri-radial and quadri-radial junction nodes. Pathway thickness is relatively uniform across the visible lateral surface.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Low-amplitude, high-frequency serrated 1D contour along the dorsal neck. The mane silhouette is clearly defined against the background with a regular jagged frequency.
dorsal_ridge_profile.contour_gaps: A notable structural discontinuity in the mane profile is visible at the posterior base of the neck, where the mane line terminates or thins significantly before the shoulder ridge.
